variables.description: Terrain altitude from ordinary lowlands through rolling hills and uplands to mountains and the highest peaks. Water coverage, underground enclosure and off-the-ground settings are separate.
variables.low: Ordinary ground and lowlands. Low altitude is unremarkable and can go unmentioned; it does not imply a depression or submerged terrain.
variables.high: Soaring summits and monumental ridgelines tower above the surrounding world.

variables.low: No ocean occupies this ground; other water features may still be present.

variables.high: The full heart of a great river dominates the terrain, its channel commanding the scene.

variables.description: A void replaces the ground. Interpret as a physical abyss or, where the setting supports it, the Void beyond ordinary reality.
variables.off: No void breaks the ground here.
variables.on: An abyss interrupts the world; in a fantastic setting this may be the Void itself, an absence beyond ordinary space.
variables.low: No void breaks the ground here.
variables.high: An abyss interrupts the world; in a fantastic setting this may be the Void itself, an absence beyond ordinary space.

steps.name: Low
steps.description: No void breaks the ground here.

steps.name: Medium
steps.description: A balanced intermediate expression of void, between its two poles; preserve the local context.

steps.name: High
steps.description: The ground gives way to a vast, fathomless absence: a black gulf where a landscape should be.

variables.description: Abundance of basic low vegetation: grasses, herbs, ferns, low shrubs and other plants appropriate to the compiled biome.
variables.low: Almost naked ground, with scarcely a blade, tuft or creeping shoot.
variables.high: Thick, vigorous ground vegetation characteristic of this biome: lush grass, abundant herbs or dense low shrubs as the setting warrants.

steps.name: Low
steps.description: Almost naked ground, with scarcely a blade, tuft or creeping shoot.

steps.name: Medium
steps.description: A balanced intermediate expression of groundcover, between its two poles; preserve the local context.

steps.name: High
steps.description: An extravagant carpet of low growth crowds every available surface in thick mats and tangled layers.

variables.description: Abundance of trees and other large plants; species and form follow the surrounding setting.
variables.low: An utterly open skyline: no trees or towering foliage, hardly a stem rising above the low growth.
variables.high: Towering growth crowds overhead in immense, overlapping masses, enclosing the scene beneath a canopy.

steps.name: Low
steps.description: An utterly open skyline: no trees or towering foliage, hardly a stem rising above the low growth.

steps.name: Medium

steps.name: High

variables.description: Ambient moisture and humidity, independent of water-feature presence and weather severity.
variables.low: Desiccating dryness: powdery surfaces, brittle textures and air that seems to draw moisture from everything.
variables.high: Saturated, clinging damp: beads of condensation, sodden textures and air heavy with moisture.

variables.description: Force and disruption of local weather, with its form supplied by the setting.
variables.low: Almost preternatural stillness: soft air and scarcely a stirring or disturbance.
variables.high: Weather at its most overwhelming: battering force, engulfing conditions and a landscape consumed by the elements.

variables.description: Amount of visible stone and bedrock, independent of elevation and vegetation.
variables.low: Stone is almost entirely hidden beneath the surface cover.
variables.high: The bones of the earth stand naked: immense slabs, fractured outcrops and raw stone dominate every view.

variables.description: Presence and interior strength of a lake or pond; positive water coverage follows the configured traversal rule.
variables.low: No lake at zero; near zero, the slenderest water margin or shallow pond edge.
variables.high: Open inland water fills the scene, gathering into the full body of a lake or pond.

variables.description: Presence of a deep open fissure that blocks exploration.
variables.off: No open chasm splits this ground.
variables.on: A yawning rupture cleaves the earth, with sheer broken walls dropping into an unseen depth.
variables.low: No open chasm splits this ground.
variables.high: A yawning rupture cleaves the earth, with sheer broken walls dropping into an unseen depth.

variables.description: Current population density: actual living inhabitants, human or non-human, independent of infrastructure, wealth, age and advancement.
variables.low: At zero, no current residents. Near zero, occasional or widely scattered inhabitants go about daily life.
variables.high: Intensely populated: throngs of residents fill a bustling city, sprawling community or equally crowded setting appropriate to infrastructure.

variables.description: How far into the past civilization impact reaches, independent of present population, sophistication or ruin condition.
variables.low: The first fresh marks of civilization: an arrival so recent that almost nothing has acquired a history.
variables.high: Civilization reaches back through lost ages: successive eras lie layered beneath memory, their beginnings swallowed by antiquity.

variables.description: Technical sophistication and capability, independent of wealth, population and infrastructure amount.
variables.low: The bare beginnings of technique: elementary tools, direct handwork and severely limited technical means.
variables.high: Staggering technical mastery: exquisitely developed methods and capabilities at the farthest limits allowed by this world.

variables.description: Disposition toward confrontation and coercion, independent of species, wealth and affiliation.
variables.low: Radical gentleness and forbearance: accommodation, restraint and an almost unshakable refusal of confrontation.
variables.high: Ruthless belligerence: threats, domination and coercion saturate social dealings, with conflict always close to the surface.

variables.description: Intensity of exchange, independent of material wealth and technical advancement.
variables.low: Exchange has dwindled to nothing: no markets, no trading bustle, scarcely anything changing hands.
variables.high: A fever of commerce: bargaining, deliveries and ceaseless exchange turn every gathering into a marketplace.

variables.description: Material resources and reserves; express scarcity or abundance in forms appropriate to the local inhabitants.
variables.low: Grinding destitution: exhausted stores, threadbare possessions and scraps hoarded against desperate need; hunger or squalor where the context supports it.
variables.high: Dazzling opulence: overflowing reserves, lavish possessions and astonishing material abundance far beyond ordinary need.

variables.description: How mixed the inhabited population is; this carries no inherent moral, political or behavioral meaning.
variables.low: An extraordinary intermingling of peoples or species, with no single population dominating the community.
variables.high: An almost complete monoculture: one people or species fills the community, with scarcely an outsider represented.

variables.description: Extent of constructed fabric, independent of current occupation, technical level, age and upkeep.
variables.low: Almost no built fabric: bare terrain, a faint track or the most minimal shelter.
variables.high: Construction overwhelms the landscape: sprawling structures, layered routes and extensive engineered systems occupy nearly every available space.

variables.description: Strength of present or past civilization impact; this is the shared presence footprint, not proof of current inhabitants.
variables.low: No civilization footprint at zero; near zero, only the faintest isolated trace of habitation or construction.
variables.high: Civilization has thoroughly marked the terrain: a powerful built or inhabited imprint, whether bustling or abandoned.

steps.name: Low
steps.description: No civilization footprint at zero; near zero, only the faintest isolated trace of habitation or construction.

steps.name: Medium
steps.description: A balanced intermediate expression of civilization impact footprint, between its two poles; preserve the local context.

steps.name: High
steps.description: Civilization has thoroughly marked the terrain: a powerful built or inhabited imprint, whether bustling or abandoned.

layers.name: Independent past-impact sites · 6–38 cells · additional sites

variables.description: Concentration of land animals, independent of organized civilization and animal species mix.
variables.low: Animal life is absent or hauntingly sparse: scarcely a movement, call or fresh track.
variables.high: Animal life throngs the place: dense gatherings and constant movement fill the scene with living bodies.

steps.name: Low
steps.description: Animal life is absent or hauntingly sparse: scarcely a movement, call or fresh track.

steps.name: High

variables.description: Animal species concentration, independent of animal abundance and aggression.
variables.low: A profusion of different animal kinds shares the habitat, with no single species prevailing.
variables.high: Almost every animal belongs to the same species: wolves upon wolves, or the local equivalent, with scarcely another kind.

variables.description: Authoritative river crossing constraint, independent of how dramatic the river is described.
variables.off: River water does not block this cell; where a river exists, this is crossing relief. Other biome blockers still apply.
variables.on: The river presents an uncrossable barrier at this cell; no narrative ford or bridge overrides that constraint.
variables.low: River water does not block this cell; where a river exists, this is crossing relief. Other biome blockers still apply.
variables.high: The river presents an uncrossable barrier at this cell; no narrative ford or bridge overrides that constraint.

variables.description: Playful imaginative tone; independent of danger, absurdity and literal supernatural power.
variables.low: Severely sober and orthodox: practical forms, earnest customs and not a trace of playful fancy.
variables.high: Exuberantly fanciful: joyous oddities, delightful flourishes and a sense of wonder spill into every fitting detail.

variables.description: Instability and disorder within established facts; never permission to contradict app state.
variables.low: Clockwork order: patterns hold, arrangements remain exact and every detail seems firmly in its place.
variables.high: Tumultuous disorder: arrangements unravel, competing forces collide and the scene feels perpetually on the verge of upheaval.

variables.description: Distance from mundane possibilities, bounded by established world facts and app mechanics.
variables.low: Resolutely mundane: ordinary materials and natural explanations, without a hint of the marvelous.
variables.high: Astonishingly otherworldly: wonders beyond ordinary experience saturate the setting, as extraordinary as established world rules permit.

variables.description: Surprise relative to this particular setting and its established expectations.
variables.low: Utterly familiar and foreseeable: each detail follows naturally from what came before.
variables.high: A succession of breathtaking reversals of expectation: startling discoveries that remain coherent with established facts.

variables.description: Density of details that invite attention; low values mean restraint, not poor narration.
variables.low: Quietly uneventful and unassuming: simple textures, few focal points and room to breathe.
variables.high: Intensely arresting: striking details and tantalizing implications compete for attention at every turn.

variables.description: Incongruity and surreal juxtaposition; independent of whimsy, danger and app-state correctness.
variables.low: Uncompromisingly sensible: conventional relationships and nothing out of place.
variables.high: Gloriously outrageous incongruity: surreal juxtapositions and straight-faced impossibilities of custom strain all ordinary expectations.

variables.description: Narrative abundance of promising openings; actual awards and availability remain app-authoritative.
variables.low: An unforgiving lack of openings: little advantage, little promise and scarcely a prospect to seize.
variables.high: Possibility seems to overflow: extraordinary openings and enticing prospects crowd the scene wherever mechanics support them.

variables.description: Atmosphere and intensity of threat; does not itself create death, damage or traversal rules.
variables.low: Profoundly sheltered and unthreatening in tone, with scarcely a sign of menace; explicit hazards still remain authoritative.
variables.high: Overwhelming menace: exposure and peril press in from every side, making every permitted choice feel consequential.

variables.description: A Certain Death occurrence whose activation and consequences must be resolved by the app, never invented by narration.
variables.off: No Certain Death occurrence is assigned here; this does not promise safety.
variables.on: An absolute terminal peril is assigned here: portray its finality vividly, but announce death only if the app resolves it.
variables.low: No Certain Death occurrence is assigned here; this does not promise safety.
variables.high: An absolute terminal peril is assigned here: portray its finality vividly, but announce death only if the app resolves it.

variables.description: A relocation occurrence; the app determines activation and destination.
variables.off: No teleport occurrence is assigned here.
variables.on: A dramatic passage to elsewhere is present: render the transition with the full character of this setting, using only the app-assigned destination and outcome.
variables.low: No teleport occurrence is assigned here.
variables.high: A dramatic passage to elsewhere is present: render the transition with the full character of this setting, using only the app-assigned destination and outcome.

variables.description: A secret discovery, counted independently of badges, possessions and statuses. Half the standalone teleport frequency.
variables.off: No relic discovery is assigned here.
variables.on: A remarkable discovery matches this scene: a physical, natural or conceptual relic, never an inventory item, badge, status or power. Reveal only on arrival, not in peeks.
variables.low: No relic discovery is assigned here.
variables.high: A remarkable discovery matches this scene: a physical, natural or conceptual relic, never an inventory item, badge, status or power. Reveal only on arrival, not in peeks.

variables.description: An award occurrence supporting status, inventory and/or badges. A co-located challenge resolves first; grant only when its requirement is satisfied.
variables.off: No gift occurrence is assigned here; this does not erase ordinary possessions or narrative generosity.
variables.on: A pointed moment of bestowal: make the authorized award feel distinctive and memorable, without increasing its assigned quantity, power or eligibility.
variables.low: No gift occurrence is assigned here; this does not erase ordinary possessions or narrative generosity.
variables.high: A pointed moment of bestowal: make the authorized award feel distinctive and memorable, without increasing its assigned quantity, power or eligibility.

variables.description: Exactly two outcomes: requirement present or absent. The app checks registered item, status or affiliation IDs before any co-located gift; AI chooses narrative valence independently.
variables.off: No challenge occurrence is assigned here; ordinary narrative difficulties may still exist.
variables.on: A decisive test confronts the traveler: make both the requirement-present and requirement-absent outcomes vivid and consequential, while preserving the app-selected branch and award eligibility.
variables.low: No challenge occurrence is assigned here; ordinary narrative difficulties may still exist.
variables.high: A decisive test confronts the traveler: make both the requirement-present and requirement-absent outcomes vivid and consequential, while preserving the app-selected branch and award eligibility.

variables.description: Built interior or constructed underground space. Veins and tiny pockets require both civilization footprint and positive infrastructure. Does not establish a separate floor or alter traversal.
variables.off: Outside any enclosed built space; construction may still surround the traveler.
variables.on: Within enclosing architecture or a constructed underground space: walls, ceilings and openings define the immediate world.
variables.low: Outside any enclosed built space; construction may still surround the traveler.
variables.high: Within enclosing architecture or a constructed underground space: walls, ceilings and openings define the immediate world.

layers.name: Tiny enclosed pockets · 1–4 cells · additional sites

variables.description: A below-ground setting in veins and small pockets, independent of civilization and Inside. Can be natural or constructed. Does not change traversal or create a separate vertical map.
variables.off: Not below ground; interpret enclosure and elevation from the other fields.
variables.on: Beneath the earth, with rock overhead. Natural caves and tunnels are possible; where infrastructure and Inside are present, the place may be a dungeon, mineshaft, cellar, crypt or constructed subterranean hall. Let the other fields determine its form.
variables.low: Not below ground; interpret enclosure and elevation from the other fields.
variables.high: Beneath the earth, with rock overhead. Natural caves and tunnels are possible; where infrastructure and Inside are present, the place may be a dungeon, mineshaft, cellar, crypt or constructed subterranean hall. Let the other fields determine its form.

variables.description: Isolated choice point. Planned app payload: seeded 2–3 choices and per-visit or once-per-life policy; outcomes use give, challenge, teleport, badge or kill. AI describes assigned results; death resets choice state.
variables.off: No structured choice occurrence is assigned here.
variables.on: A distinct fork in possibility: two or three memorable choices offer app-assigned outcomes, expressed through the character of this place.
variables.low: No structured choice occurrence is assigned here.
variables.high: A distinct fork in possibility: two or three memorable choices offer app-assigned outcomes, expressed through the character of this place.

variables.description: Commitment to local political, factional or religious affiliations, independent of friendliness and hostility.
variables.low: Loose attachment: affiliations make few demands on daily life.
variables.high: Consuming devotion: allegiance pervades identity, ritual and expectations.

variables.description: Physical elevation above the local ground, independent of terrain altitude. Interpret together with vegetation, civilization and infrastructure. This field does not itself grant flight or change traversability.
variables.low: At zero the scene rests on the ground. A faint positive value lifts the occupied place slightly: raised roots, low platforms or stilt-supported ground, as the setting allows.
variables.high: The occupied place rises high above local ground: treehouses and canopy walkways where trees and construction support them, suspended settlements, or floating islands where fantasticness permits. Choose a fitting form, not all examples; this grants no flight or extra exits.

variables.description: Sensory vividness and expressive color, independent of danger, weather severity and supernatural power.
variables.low: Subdued colors, muted sensory impressions and restrained expression.
variables.high: Intensely vivid colors, striking sensory richness and exuberant expression saturate the scene.

variables.description: Perceptual and sensory strangeness, independent of whimsy, menace and actual danger; changes presentation, never mechanical outcomes.
variables.low: Crisp, stable and plainly perceived: colors, forms and sensations remain grounded and unambiguous.
variables.high: Overwhelming sensory transformation: shifting sensory patterns, fluid geometry and mingling sensations saturate the world with dreamlike intensity.

variables.description: Intensity of fear and dread, independent of actual danger or death; atmosphere cannot invent hazards or outcomes.
variables.low: Deeply reassuring and emotionally secure: familiar rhythms and a profound absence of dread.
variables.high: Visceral, consuming terror: oppressive scale, dreadful presence and unnerving detail make the surroundings feel almost unbearable.

variables.description: Dream logic and impossible relationships between otherwise recognizable things, independent of sensory distortion, whimsy and danger. Shapes presentation, never gameplay rules.
variables.low: Ordinary relationships and coherent physical arrangements: the place makes immediate, practical sense.
variables.high: Dream logic reshapes the scene: impossible juxtapositions, uncanny scale and unexpected relationships feel strangely inevitable. Keep supplied geography and exits intact; surrealism invents no encounters or powers.
